summary: Frontend-only test of new collapsible sidebar + multi-tab workspace in /admin. Logged in via Clerk admin+clerk_test@shop.com + TOTP (admin console). All 7 required behaviours functionally work (tabs add on nav click, URL ?s= syncs, panels stay mounted so filter/search text is preserved when switching, close-all appears only with >1 tabs, right-click context menu with 關閉/關閉其他/關閉全部 works, reload restores LS admin_tabs and ?s= active tab, sidebar collapse persists via LS admin_sidebar_collapsed and width ~64px with labels hidden, hover flyout appears). Two issues found: (1) HIGH – flyout from collapsed sidebar is overlapped by main-content cards and intercepts pointer events, breaking clicks on items past the first row; (2) MINOR – context-menu/close tooltip renders '关闭' (Simplified) while sibling buttons render '關閉其他'/'關閉全部' (Traditional) — i18n inconsistency in tr() table.

ui_bugs.component: Admin collapsed sidebar flyout (NavGroup collapsed branch, Admin.jsx ~L67-85)
ui_bugs.issue: When sidebar is collapsed and user hovers admin-group-<key>, the flyout container (left-full z-50) is painted behind the <main> content. Main-content cards (e.g., member-stat-total) intercept pointer events, so most flyout items are unclickable. Playwright click on admin-nav-members from flyout failed with 'subtree intercepts pointer events' because the member-stat-total card sits over the flyout at y≈193. Root cause: <aside> uses sticky positioning (its own stacking context) but has no z-index, while sibling <main> paints after it in DOM order with equal effective z. Only the first flyout row (above the stat cards) is reachable.

ui_bugs.component: TabBar context menu (Admin.jsx L174-180) and tab close tooltip (L168)
ui_bugs.issue: Mixed Simplified+Traditional Chinese: first context-menu button and X-icon title render '关闭' (Simplified) while '關閉其他' / '關閉全部' remain Traditional. Spec requires 關閉/關閉其他/關閉全部. Issue is in the i18n table mapping for tr('關閉').

issues: Flyout rendered behind main-content cards due to missing z-index on <aside> or portal fallback

action_items: Fix collapsed-sidebar flyout z-index: add `z-30`/`z-40` (or `relative z-30`) to <aside data-testid="admin-sidebar"> in Admin.jsx L239 so its sticky stacking context sits above <main>, OR render the hover flyout in a portal with fixed positioning. Verify by hovering admin-group-users while sidebar is collapsed on the Members page and clicking admin-nav-member-assets (behind the stat cards).
Fix tr('關閉') translation entry so it stays Traditional like its siblings (關閉/關閉其他/關閉全部) — affects admin-tab-context-menu first item and admin-tab-close-<k> tooltip.
critical_code_review_comments: Admin.jsx is 463 lines but imports ~35 subpages and defines TabBar+Currencies+Promos+PaymentLogos inline — consider splitting the inline Currencies/Promos/PaymentLogos components out of Admin.jsx to keep it a pure shell.
NavGroup collapsed flyout uses CSS :hover (group-hover) only — no keyboard focus trigger, so keyboard navigation cannot open the flyout. Minor a11y gap.

closeOthers / closeAll don't preserve the previously-mounted non-closed panels' state intentionally; that's fine. But closeTab's active-switch math uses `tabs.indexOf(k)` before setTabs — if the closed tab was last, index drops; works but worth a comment.

pushUrl uses history.pushState for every setSection — switching between already-open tabs via click also pushes a new history entry (confirmed by browser back navigating between tabs). Acceptable, matches spec 'browser back/forward switch tabs'.

success_rate.frontend: 85% (6/7 scenarios fully pass; collapsed flyout clickability blocked by z-index bug)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin shell multi-tab + collapsible sidebar functionally works. After E1 fixes the flyout z-index, re-verify by: login → /admin → click admin-sidebar-toggle → go to members (via flyout) → hover admin-group-users → click admin-nav-member-assets (which sits behind the stat cards area). Also verify the tr('關閉') label fix in the context menu.
